email_subject: Application - Ecommerce Product Catalog & Research Analyst
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I am writing to apply for the Ecommerce Product Catalog & Research Analyst position at Jobgether. With a background in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, I have hands-on experience managing product data and creating accurate, high-quality online content.

At Episto, I build and maintain client websites in WordPress, ensuring product listings are complete and up-to-date. On my own project, mirook.com, I implemented structured data and conducted technical audits to improve search visibility. I am proficient in Excel and Word, and familiar with AI-powered research tools. My technical foundation in computer science helps me quickly understand IT hardware, software, and cloud solutions.

I am detail-oriented, organized, and thrive in fast-paced environments. I am eager to apply my skills to keep your product catalog accurate and competitive.

Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,

Dear Hiring Team,

I am excited to apply for the Ecommerce Product Catalog & Research Analyst role at Jobgether. With a strong foundation in digital marketing, SEO, and web development, combined with a technical background in computer science, I am confident in my ability to maintain a high-quality product catalog.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage on-page SEO and content for client websites, often working with WordPress and ecommerce platforms. I have experience creating and updating product listings, ensuring accuracy in descriptions, specifications, and images. My work on mirook.com involved implementing structured data (JSON-LD) and conducting technical audits, which required meticulous attention to detail and the ability to identify and correct discrepancies. I am proficient in Microsoft Excel and Word, and I regularly use AI-powered tools for research and data extraction.

I have a solid understanding of technology products, including IT hardware, software, and cloud solutions, which I have developed through my coursework in Applied Computer Science and my hands-on experience in web development. I am adept at researching unfamiliar products, interpreting technical specifications, and converting complex information into clear, customer-friendly content. My organizational skills and ability to prioritize multiple assignments allow me to meet deadlines without compromising accuracy.

I am eager to bring my research and analytical skills to your team, ensuring that your product catalog remains complete, current, and competitive. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
